description: Cardex takes traditional card visual and extend it to include advanced formatting for visual elements. This visual provides rich formatting options with automatic and manual conditional formatting for fill, border,images, data and category labels. With this you can control the precision on the positioning and formatting of the visual elements like border,label, fill etc. Key features: Display blank measure as static value. Tailor the shape o the visual using custom border. Supports large font up to 150px. Conditional formatting: Identify and highlight data points,trends based on the rules for data label and category.. Label & Category: Improve readability and control position and size of data point. Fill: Compare data points at a glance by filling the space of label,category to indicate the magnitude. Supports visual cross filter & synchronization.
